exam_scheme.note: The Engineering Services Examination is conducted across four engineering disciplines: Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, and Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering. The selection process has three sequential stages: Preliminary (Objective, 500 marks), Main (Conventional / Descriptive, 600 marks), and Personality Test (Interview, 200 marks) for a total final merit evaluation out of 1300 marks. In Stage I objective papers, a penalty of one-third (0.33) marks applies for every incorrect response.
